data_read_back: an adapter health verdict recorded with its reason

user_outcome: OUTCOME-12 Connect VECTOR through MCP safely
data_read_back: an authorized read returns isolated data with a correlation id
authz_rule: a capability is required per tool; peer identity is fixed by the session
negative_case: a missing capability, an out-of-scope path, a traversal, oversized arguments, an unknown method, malformed JSON and a pre-handshake call are all refused
restart_persistence_case: the session survives a refused call and answers the next one
concurrency_case: one peer per process; the audit log is append-only

user_outcome: OUTCOME-13 Turn crashes into reproducible gated repair PRs
data_written: a redacted crash bundle and a git worktree on disk
data_read_back: the bundle digest and the worktree contents are read back; the gate exit code is recorded
authz_rule: explicit learner consent per report; the scope forbids learner state
negative_case: a secret-bearing bundle is blocked from sharing; a scope permitting learner data is refused before anything is created
restart_persistence_case: the node stored in the bundle survives a restart; the worktree is removed on drop
concurrency_case: worktree creation verifies isolation and the absence of learner state

user_outcome: OUTCOME-14 Back up, restore, recover and export data
command_or_route: tauri commands backup_create, backup_list and backup_restore
data_read_back: the manifest checksum and attempt rows are read back; the archive is re-listed from disk before success is claimed
negative_case: a tampered archive is refused by digest and live state is left unchanged
restart_persistence_case: a cold restart opens the restored database
concurrency_case: restore takes exclusive access and replaces the connection

user_outcome: OUTCOME-15 Install and run a reproducible production artifact
data_written: MSI and NSIS installers plus the desktop binary
data_read_back: the artifact digest is measured and re-measured after each bundling step; the webview marker is read back from the real database by a separate process
authz_rule: package signature policy is not satisfiable without the release key
negative_case: the live-fire check fails if the artifact exits before the webview reaches the command layer
restart_persistence_case: markers accumulate across launches and each launch is identified by its bundle stamp
concurrency_case: a single updater lock is not applicable
